services.title: Pre-Wedding Video Editing
services.tagline: Cinematic romantic visual poetry with rhythmic cuts & drone pacing
services.shortDescription: Transform your pre-wedding raw footage into a dreamy, high-fashion cinematic love story with custom soundscapes.
services.detailedDescription: Full post-production treatment for pre-wedding shoots. Includes multi-camera audio sync, cinematic slow-motion speed ramps, specialized film-look color grading, personalized song mixing, dialogue mastering, and vertical teaser cuts for social media.
inclusions: Hollywood Grade Film Tone & Color Palette
exclusions: Raw footage shooting / camera equipment on location
Travel, food, lodging for shoot crew
Drone license permits or venue access charges

services.title: Wedding Video Highlights
services.tagline: Emotionally immersive master highlights capturing timeless rituals & celebrations

services.title: Haldi & Sangeeth Ceremonies

Haldi Color Splash Pop & Yellow HDR Grading
exclusions: On-site video recording crew or sound stage setup
Travel, food, and local venue access charges

testimonials.reviewText: Bharath Kumar gave us chills with our wedding highlight film! The way he synced our Mangalashtak mantras with the emotional teary-eyed moments of our parents was pure magic. Delivered right on time and in stunning 4K quality!

The private client delivery locker made it so easy for us to stream the master cut and download our full-res 4K videos without sharing it on a messy public Google Drive. 10/10 service and true data isolation!
KBK Film Studios covered our Gruhapravesam video editing with immense dignity, clear Vedic mantras audio, and crisp cinematic lighting. Highly recommended for any family celebration.
